en: The New menu now offers New conversation and New project. Create a project folder or register an existing folder without moving its files.
Saved projects persist even when empty. Start a conversation from the + beside a project, or choose a saved project in the new-conversation dialog.
Include saved empty projects in linked-directory choices and native task menus; synchronize project creation across windows and validate folder names and collisions.
zh: “新建”菜单提供“新对话”和“新项目”。支持创建项目文件夹或使用已有文件夹，现有文件留在原处。
已保存的空项目持续保留在侧栏。点击项目旁的“＋”可新建对话，也可在新对话窗口选择已保存的项目。
关联项目和任务右键菜单纳入已保存的空项目；项目创建同步到其他窗口，并校验文件夹名称和重名冲突。
